name: brand
intendedUse: Compact TunnelTend identity (The Fold) for project pickers, product links, provider-style rows and other icon slots where the formal lockup is unsuitable.

license.notes: Wolfsblvt Works geometry. The paths are the approved The Fold tintable master from Wolfsblvt/tunneltend, drawn by the same maker.

modifications: None to the path data. The tintable master (brand/bundle/tunneltend/assets/mark-primary/on-light-tintable.svg at Wolfsblvt/tunneltend@09d53a473de6db9b29ad1aa67e44252dc8a82bc4, SHA-256 f0b34ebf99cc899c559e8e4992985caca8e01f3f455d45c1e45759ef8262b77c) already uses the 24 grid, 2px round strokes and currentColor; only the XML layout was reformatted.

redistribution.notes: Distributed from this repository with the package source. The coloured Fold, wordmark, lockups, favicon and application icon remain TunnelTend's own identity assets in its brand bundle; the package carries only the monochrome line glyph.

authoringNotes: The Fold is two independent rounded paths nested in a stable turn, with the inner stroke deliberately asymmetrical. Never mirror it, close either path, add a third line or read it as status. TunnelTend's favicon variant (2.35px stroke, shorter tails) is not carried because the icon standard fixes 2px strokes.
